name: refactor_ts_manual_null_chain_to_optional_chaining
description: Refactors a manual null/undefined-chasing chain into optional chaining and nullish coalescing
prompts: cityOf(user) in cityof.ts extracts user.address.city, falling back to "Unknown" whenever user, user.address, or user.address.city is missing (null/undefined at any level). It does this with a manual `if (user && user.address && ...)` chain of explicit checks. Refactor it to use optional chaining (`?.`) and the nullish-coalescing operator (`??`) instead of the manual chain. Do not change observable behavior: a fully-populated user still returns the city, and a missing user / missing address / missing or null city all still return exactly "Unknown". Keep the function name and signature (user: User | null | undefined).

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build cityof.ts
node behavior_test.js
